# `factory/llm.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › [Execution environment and infrastructure](../../subsystems/execution-environment-and-infrastructure.md) › `llm.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Central entry point for all LLM queries in the system. Provides a unified interface to OpenAI-compatible model endpoints, handles request/response marshaling, validates structured output against schemas, tracks usage and costs, manages retry logic and provider fallbacks, and journals all model calls.

1,343 lines, in Execution environment and infrastructure.
